summary: In Step 1, I waited for 5000ms after launching the EVIA app. The screen transitioned from the initial splash screen to the main application interface, which is now partially obscured by an "App not responding" system dialog. This dialog displays the message "prm393_lab03 isn't responding" with options to "Close app" or "Wait". Behind the dialog, the app's main screen is visible, showing the text "Discover exciting events, join what you love, and earn rewards along the way" along with "Get Started", "Log In", and "Explore as Guest" buttons.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Wait' button on the 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' dialog box. The dialog disappeared, revealing the main 'Welcome to Evia!' screen. This screen displays the app logo, a character illustration, the text 'Welcome to Evia!', and the subtext 'Discover exciting events, join what you love, and earn rewards along the way.' Below this, the buttons 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest' are now visible and accessible on the screen.

In Step 3, I tapped the 'Explore as Guest' text at the bottom of the welcome screen. Immediately following the tap, an 'App Not Responding' dialog appeared over the interface, displaying the message 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' along with two selectable options: 'Close app' and 'Wait'. The underlying welcome screen, featuring the 'Get Started' and 'Log In' buttons, remained visible behind the modal dialog.

In Step 4, I tapped the 'Wait' button on the 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' system dialog. Following this action, the dialog disappeared from the screen, revealing the underlying 'Welcome to Evia!' landing page. This screen displays the app logo, a character illustration, the text 'Welcome to Evia!', and three interactive options: 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest'. The system dialog is no longer present, and the application interface is now visible.

In Step 5, I tapped the 'Explore as Guest' text button marked in red on the welcome screen. Immediately following this action, an application dialog titled 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' appeared centered over the view. This dialog presents two options, 'Close app' and 'Wait', while the underlying welcome screen remains visible in the background with the 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest' buttons still present.

In Step 6, I force-stopped the 'prm393_lab03' application, which was previously displaying an 'isn't responding' dialog with 'Close app' and 'Wait' options. Following this action, the screen transitioned from the unresponsive app state to the Android home screen. The home screen now displays standard system icons including Play Store, Gmail, Photos, YouTube, Phone, Messages, and Chrome, along with the Google search bar at the bottom, indicating that the application is no longer active in the foreground.

In Step 7, I launched the 'prm393_lab03' application from the Android home screen. The display transitioned from the home interface to a plain white splash screen, which features a centered blue ticket-shaped icon containing a lowercase white 'e'. No other text, interactive buttons, or navigation elements are visible on this screen, and the application currently appears to be in a loading state as the interface remains static on this splash graphic.

In Step 8, I tapped the 'Explore as Guest' text at the bottom of the screen; immediately, an Android system dialog titled 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' appeared over the application interface. This dialog provides 'Close app' and 'Wait' options, obscuring the center of the screen. The underlying view remains visible, showing the 'evia' logo, a character illustration, and the buttons 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest' beneath the dialog box.

In Step 9, I tapped the 'Wait' button on the 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' dialog box marked in red. Following this action, the dialog box disappeared from the screen, revealing the underlying 'Welcome to Evia!' landing page. This screen displays the app logo, a character illustration, and three primary navigation options: 'Get Started', 'Log In', and 'Explore as Guest'. The interface is now clear of any error messages or system dialogs, and the main welcome screen is fully visible.

In Step 10, I tapped the 'Explore as Guest' text link marked in red on the welcome screen; immediately following this action, a system dialog titled 'prm393_lab03 isn't responding' appeared over the interface, presenting 'Close app' and 'Wait' options. The underlying welcome screen, which includes the 'Get Started' and 'Log In' buttons, remains visible behind the modal dialog, and no further navigation to the Discover screen occurred.
